name: @w6w-apps/sharetribe
description: Manage marketplace users, listings, transactions and stock through Sharetribe's Integration API, plus read-only marketplace asset config.

w6w.longDescription:
Sharetribe is a marketplace-as-a-service platform: operators run a two-sided marketplace (listings, users, bookings/orders, payments) on it without building the marketplace engine themselves. This app covers Sharetribe's Integration API — the trusted, server-side surface meant for backend systems and marketplace operators, with full read/write access to marketplace data (as opposed to the Marketplace API, which is what the marketplace's own end-user-facing client authenticates as a single logged-in user against).

Its centre of gravity is the marketplace lifecycle an operator automates: reading and querying users and listings; creating, updating, closing, opening and approving listings; querying and transitioning transactions through an operator-triggered step in the marketplace's transaction process; adjusting a listing's available stock with an optimistic compare-and-set; and polling the append-only event log that records every change in the marketplace. A small set of read-only actions also cover the separate, unauthenticated Asset Delivery API, which serves a marketplace's own published configuration and content assets by client ID.

Health checks track Sharetribe's own status page, which names the Integration, Marketplace, Authentication and Asset Delivery APIs as independent components.
